message.content:
**1) Close button visibility:** Clearly visible — dark circular button with a gold/amber ring and white X icon. It stands out well against the dark modal background.

**2) Overlap:** Yes — it sits directly on top of the body text in the modal, obscuring the beginning of the first paragraph line ("اوراقی که..."). The text flows behind/around it rather than clearing it.

**3) Dark mode quality:** Good overall. Modal background has proper contrast with the page's dimmed backdrop, and the title (white) and red badge text are readable. Minor issues:
- Body text is mid-gray and slightly low contrast, made worse by the X overlapping it.
- The red "علیه قیمت طلا" label is legible but could be brighter.

**Fix suggestion:** Reserve a clear space for the X button (e.g., padding-top/inline-start in the modal body) or move it to a corner, and bump body text to a lighter gray (~#cbd5e1).
